description: Convert the image to another colour mode (Image > Mode): RGB, CMYK, Grayscale, Lab, Bitmap, Indexed Color or Multichannel, and/or another bit depth. Indexed Color takes the palette, colours, forced colours, transparency, matte and dither of its dialog; Bitmap (from Grayscale) takes the method, output resolution and halftone screen. Returns the document with its mode. Converting can flatten or discard information

bitmap.description: Bitmap options (mode "bitmap"; the image must be Grayscale)

frequency.description: Halftone screen frequency, lines per inch

colors.description: Number of colours, for the local and master palettes and uniform

dither.description: How to simulate colours not in the table

forced.description: Colours always kept in the table

matte.description: Colour that fills antialiased edges next to transparent areas

preserveExactColors.description: With diffusion dither, keep colours that are in the table undithered

name: change_mode
title: Change Mode
